title: Alex de Minaur Eliminated in US Open Upset
summary: Australian tennis player Alex de Minaur has been eliminated from the US Open following a significant upset. The specific details of his opponent and the match outcome were not provided in the coverage.
summary_points: Alex de Minaur has been eliminated from the US Open.
The elimination is described as a massive upset.
Further match details were not included in the provided coverage.
title_hi: एलेक्स डी मिनौर यूएस ओपन से बाहर

summary_points_hi: एलेक्स डी मिनौर यूएस ओपन से बाहर हो गए हैं।
